correctness.rationale: After integral translation the tower is Phi_p(Y^(2^k)+2j). Over Q(zeta_p), a root is a 2^k-th root of zeta_p-2j. Squarefreeness of its norm gives irreducibility and local maximality at odd primes. At primes above 2, the exact binomial valuations determine a regular Newton polygon whose lattice-point count is 2^k-2^(k-min(v_2(j),k)); summing residue degrees gives the stated absolute exponent. The finite checker verifies the Newton combinatorics but is not used as proof.

value.rationale: This is the exact arithmetic invariant controlling the boundary of a newly introduced monogenic tower. It converts the source's parity sufficiency into a complete dyadic index profile at every level, showing how the obstruction grows with both iteration depth and v_2(j); this is a structural extension rather than a routine numerical case.
